stops.name: via naturae

stops.english: Forest trails, nature trails, orchard trails, water trails, youth adventure trails as well as a red deer trail, a viticulture trail, an agricultural trail, the "via naturae" in Heidelberg and a medicinal herb garden in Eberbach
